reviews.text: Chico is an excellent professional; his work is very efficient and yields great results.

Francisco Rondon's work combines technical competence, efficient communication, and great care in building relationships. A top-notch professional whom I recommend without hesitation. Paulina thanks him!
Francisco is a great professional. He was super patient with my dog, attentive even outside of class. The investment and learning experience were worthwhile. I recommend him without hesitation!!!

Francisco is one of a kind! He came to help us with Chico, our 5-year-old dog, and since then his behavior has completely changed! Today, even with all his anxiety, he manages to have a much better relationship with me and my husband. And when he sees Francisco in training, it's like he's mesmerized; he's a true dog whisperer. I recommend him without hesitation!

It was truly impressive to learn about Chico's work. So much learning 🤍 We are very grateful for the guidance. Our girls were ruining our entire yard. The lawn at home didn't even exist anymore. We never thought there would be a solution. We had already tried everything. It was incredible. Cats, children, plants, lawn and parents thank you.

Amazing!!!!

Very attentive, trustworthy, secure, firm, and balanced!!!
Excellent professional, top-notch consulting with wonderful guidance and recommendations for caring for my cats.

10 stars, actually. Attentive, polite, kind, generous and, more than anything, he understands the animal's soul well. It wasn't classic training, but something more behavioral, which also involved some command lessons.
I haven't started the actual training yet, but I had an evaluation done for my dog ​​and Francisco was very attentive throughout the entire process.

Francisco is an excellent professional! We have a reactive dog with certain traumas from a previous training attempt, and he did a great job! He explained how to teach the dog by stimulating him through rewards and not punishments, which completely changed the way we deal with him.
Besides that, he was always super attentive, sending messages to find out how the process was going, giving tips, asking for videos. He was exactly what we needed!

I highly recommend him!

Francisco is exactly what we expect from an experienced dog trainer. Attentive, detail-oriented, and very, very patient. Furthermore, he is clearly a pet lover. A genuine guy and an excellent professional. In this case, he helped our dog Luck (2 years old), found on the street, get used to our 4 kittens (Shoyu, Pipoca, Paçoca, and the grumpy Sushi). Everything went well.

I highly recommend the trainer's work! My three cats were constantly fighting, and I didn't know what to do anymore. With patience and extensive knowledge of feline behavior, he managed to end the conflicts, and today they live together in peace. A thoughtful and competent professional, I highly recommend him!

Francisco is a sensational dog trainer! In a short time, he managed to identify Sol's problems, which we, as owners, never noticed in our daily lives. Throughout the lessons, Sol's improvement was noticeable; she became much calmer at various times, in addition to learning several important commands. I highly recommend him!

We sought out Francisco to help resolve issues of coexistence between our dog, who has been with us for 6 years, and another dog we recently rescued due to some fighting incidents. During this training period, we learned to recognize each dog's boundaries and to perform commands that help them get along. From the very first moment, we received excellent guidance. Francisco, besides being an excellent professional, is a wonderful person and is always available to answer our questions! I can only express my gratitude because the progress of both dogs is evident!

I highly recommend him!
We hired Francisco to improve the relationship between my recently rescued puppy and a very temperamental Shih Tzu that we already had, and they were fighting a lot! I had already tried another professional who didn't give me any results, quite the opposite, it only got worse… I was almost giving up when I found Francisco!
From the first visit, he was super attentive, an exceptional professional, technically skilled, very dedicated and committed! In addition to the in-person service, he was always providing support via WhatsApp (even after the classes ended).
We had a total of 10 classes and saw a huge improvement in their behavior…. Before, they couldn't even be left alone together at home!! Thank you!!! I highly recommend him.
Francisco was very attentive, and with his suggestions, I quickly saw changes in my canine companion's behavior! I highly recommend him!

Excellent professional.

You can trust him.
Excellent. Francisco gave great tips and in just one week I saw a lot of progress in my puppy's behavior.
Francisco is excellent! He was attentive to my dog's needs and worked in partnership with me. He was very caring and committed to our plans. I highly recommend him!

Francisco works with great care and patience. He's a great trainer; he suggested techniques and materials that led to success!!! My dog, who used to live in a house and then moved to an apartment, had a habit since she was a puppy (she's 10 years old) of peeing in the yard, meaning she never peed inside the house. With the lessons and "homework," she finally peed in the natural grass toilet inside the house for the first time, and then did it again without command. We knew from the beginning that it would be a lengthy process, especially since it's years of routine. And everything worked out!

Francisco is extremely attentive.
He oversaw the training process for my Amstaff in the first few months of her life, and it was wonderful.
He has always been available to answer any questions.

Excellent professional! Francisco helped me with a mission that seemed difficult: teaching my two dogs to relieve themselves in the Weasy. One of them is already 15 years old, which made the process even more challenging.
From the beginning, he demonstrated great knowledge, patience, and sensitivity in dealing with the characteristics of each animal. He followed the training patiently and efficiently, always guiding the owners on how to continue the process.
The result was exactly what I expected: the adaptation happened smoothly (it took a while, but it happened) and the mission was successfully accomplished. I recommend Francisco's work to anyone looking for a competent, committed trainer who truly understands animal behavior.
Francisco is an excellent dog trainer; he brought many solutions to my dogs and helped them a lot with their bad habits. I highly recommend his work.
Francisco was essential in helping us adjust some behavioral aspects with our Margot! Training with love, respect, care, and attention to the animal's needs. We recommend him without hesitation!!

Francisco is an excellent professional and a great person. Kind, technically skilled, he handles situations well when needed. We had a very mischievous puppy who was having trouble getting his urine on the mat. We were able to make significant progress and manage these and other situations thanks to his teachings. A fortunate choice of professional who has always been very careful and attentive to us and our Snoopy.

Excellent professional! He possesses a wide range of skills with dogs, in addition to being extremely patient and loving with both the animals and their owners. Charismatic, good-humored, technically skilled, creative, and more than capable of practicing the art of dog training. A sure recommendation!
Without a doubt the best!
Good
My Mike isn't a very sociable dog, but Francisco quickly understood how he reacts and treated him with so much love during the days I had to travel. I trust Francisco completely!
Excellent professional. Dedicated and committed.
Excellent work!
Francisco is an excellent, competent, and reliable professional who loves animals!
